editorial:
Moving to a new town can feel boring, but Zach Cooper gets a wild surprise when he meets Hannah, the girl next door, and her famous dad, R.L. Stine. Soon, real monsters jump out of locked Goosebumps manuscripts and turn the quiet town into a noisy, spooky playground. You get a fun mix of scares, laughs, and adventure as Zach, Hannah, and Stine race to trap every creature back in its book. The movie keeps things light, so younger viewers can enjoy the thrills without feeling overwhelmed.

Jack Black brings big energy as Stine, while Dylan Minnette and Odeya Rush make the teen heroes easy to root for. The action moves fast, the monsters look lively, and the jokes land often enough to keep you smiling. Some moments feel predictable, and a few effects look a little dated, but the heart and humor carry it. If you want a family-friendly spooky night, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final act, the monsters are pulled back into a giant new manuscript, but Slappy tries to stop them. Zach and Hannah trap Slappy inside a book, and the town returns to normal. The twist reveals Hannah is also a fictional character from Stine’s writing, yet she stays real because Stine chooses to keep her alive. The movie ends with Stine starting a new story, hinting more adventures could come.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family-friendly spooky adventures and monster mayhem.
